name: Surface stairwell, down into Zone 0: Intake Hall
narrator_line: A horn sounds across the city, and stairwells open in the pavement, each firing a beam of light into the sky. The entrances stay open for one hour.
read_aloud: A horn sounds across the city, and stairwells open in the pavement, each firing a beam of light into the sky. The entrances stay open for one hour. Anyone still on the surface when they close remains a Native. Walk down: you become a Crawler the moment your foot touches Floor 1, not one stair sooner.

map.layout: Street level: a stairwell has opened in the pavement with a beam of light shooting straight up out of it, and concrete steps lead down into the light.
map.hazards: The one-hour entrance window: the System counts it down (canon M-539, M-545).

voice_lines.intro: A horn sounds across the city, and stairwells open in the pavement, each firing a beam of light into the sky. The entrances stay open for one hour.
voice_lines.twist: That chime was your foot touching Floor 1. A booth door swings open and waits.
voice_lines.win: Paperwork filed. Nameplates printed, at least one misspelled. Welcome to the Orientation Pit. The booths open onto an atrium.
